correctness.rationale: Flow conservation makes the three off-diagonal high-minus-low differences equal to a common nonzero integer t. After orientation and ordering the low entries, the six off-diagonal positions have only five possible low/high interleavings; inserting the three loops gives exactly 420 length-relevant shape classes, with 72 labeled rankings per shape. For fixed t, adjacent strict inequalities are lower-bound difference constraints in six base variables; longest-path closure gives the componentwise least nonnegative feasible solution and hence the minimum positive linear length objective. An independent exact-integer replay over all 420 shapes and t=1,...,28 reproduced maximum 86 and a unique worst shape. Since total length is at least 3t, t>=29 cannot improve a <=86 witness. For the unique worst shape, three distinct loops between b+t and c+t force c-b>=4 and c<b+t forces t>=5, giving the sharp minimum values 0,5,6,10,11,12,13,14,15 with sum 86. The displayed balanced matrix attains them and its strongly connected balanced directed support has an Euler circuit, producing a circular realizing string of length 86.
